subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about validated leads for {Brand}. With Facebook Marketplace pulling free second-hand listings on the phone, paid acquisition in South Africa sits in a volatile band: Facebook lead CPLs ran from R66 up to a January 2026 spike of R179 (superads 2025). That spread is where validated-lead screening and a holdout decide your real cost per posting buyer or seller. We measure paid leads against a control so they read as incremental. Worth a side-by-side look?
angle: fresh angle: Facebook Marketplace free-listing pressure + sourced South Africa CPL band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN classifieds South Africa: acknowledges 2nd follow-up and references prior email; fresh angle = timely development (Facebook Marketplace free listings, rotated peer from brand_candidates) plus REAL web-verified South Africa Facebook CPL band R66 to R179 (superads, URL in enrichment_sources, retrieved and confirmed); no hedge word before any number; MobUpps holdout/incrementality referenced with no figure; 1 question mark; native English; no sign-off; no em dash; no 'X, not Y'.
